text:
maria: Quick sync — final scrub of quant recs for the OptKit delivery. I have a short checklist of PRs + smoke tasks. Who can own the remaining CRs and the regression runs tomorrow? checklist: https://go/internal/optkit/checklist :eyes:

sam: I can take the CRs for the core quant kernels. When's the code freeze for the delivery?

maria: Code freeze EOD Tuesday. Also need someone to run the nightly regression harness on prod-like infra (batch sizes up to 64).

lee: I can run the harness. Tell me the model docker tag and perf flags. @maria share the tag here.

maria: Tag is `optimize-v3-quant-rc`. Perf flags: `--batching=dynamic --kv-cache=on --max-seq=2048`.

lee: Got it, kicking off a smoke now. I'll post failures + perf numbers in this thread.

anya: I can own the caching-layer unit/regression tests. Saw a flaky earlier around prefix eviction — might be related to TTL/size heuristics.

sam: Noted. PR #482 touches eviction heuristics. @ken can you review that one? It's a small change but important.

ken: On it, will review in the next 2 hrs.

maria: Also we need an owner for the rollback/fallback policy if the quant variant regresses in canary. Proposal: auto-fallback to the FP16 variant + create a pager alert. @oliver would you pick this up?

oliver: Agree with auto-fallback. I'll wire the fallback in router logic and add the pager + a short runbook entry.

qa-bot: Regression alert: nightly-smoke FAILED on batch_size=64 for `optimize-v3-quant-rc`. Failing test: `tokenization-consistency`. CI logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/optkit/3039998888/run1

nora: I'll triage the tokenization-consistency failure. Quick hypothesis: token offset change from the new preproc micro-optim broke padding/truncation. Will validate.

maria: Thanks. If it's not a quick fix, we should gate the rollout and ensure fallback to FP16 is ready.

lee: Summary from harness run: two flaky tests, one deterministic fail on `tokenization-consistency`. Logs uploaded to s3: `s3://redwood-ci/optkit/3039998888/run1/` — CPU/GPU perf numbers in the artifact.

anya: If tokenization is the culprit, that could be the preproc optimization I added (token cache warm path). I'll prepare a patch to revert that micro-optim and run unit tests.

maria: Action items (short):
- sam -> finish CRs on quant kernels (assign reviewers).
- ken -> review eviction PR (#482).
- lee -> complete smoke runs + post perf summary.
- anya -> open revert PR for preproc micro-optim if triage points to it.
- oliver -> implement fallback + pager + runbook.
- nora -> triage tokenization failure and report root cause.
I'll update the release board and hold rollout until we have green or fallback in place.

sam: :thumbsup: pinging reviewers now, will update PRs and link diffs.

ken: Reviewed #482, left minor comments. Happy to approve once CI is green.

maria: Thanks everyone. If anyone wants to pair on triage, I'm free 2–4pm PT today. @everyone please drop short status updates in this thread so we can keep async momentum. :raised_hands:
